notes: What the author is asking to be built is a place and a mood — a pastel flower field under fluffy clouds with Angel standing in it and a koi pond to visit — because the game itself is picking answers toward one of five endings, which is dialogue rather than layout, and no genre in the index describes it. So this is No Genre with Explorable Place, keeping its circulation and composed scenic views and dropping landmark-focal since the prompt names no distant structure to anchor on; the koi pond lands on water-body and Angel on npc-population, which is exactly the named figure that row exists for. With no user to ask, I left all five axes at their defaults: the author confirmed all five endings play out in the flower field, so there is one surface rather than several maps, and the 1am bedroom is a small vignette staged on that same surface instead of an interior the player transitions into, which keeps this off P3 and P4. The creepy turn is in the writing and presentation rather than the geometry, so nothing here routes for it.
